$comment: One chapter = this file + content/ink/<id>.ink. The Ink script decides the order; this file tunes each playable section. Copy it to make the next chapter.
title: Tataka's Wasteland
note: In Valmiki's telling, Tataka was born a yakshini, strong as a thousand elephants, and was cursed to become a rakshasi. She emptied the lands around her of people. When Rama faced her she raised dust, rained stones and made herself invisible.

walk.hint: Hold the left side to walk. Tap a glowing mark.

hotspots.text: A dry well. The rope still hangs, frayed to nothing.
Huts with their roofs torn off. Pots lie where they were dropped.
A giant's footprint, pressed deep into the cracked earth.

battle.rule: Watch the ground: a shadow-star means danger is coming there.

say.speaker: rama
say.text: I will stop her, not kill her. She is a woman.

say.speaker: vishvamitra
say.text: Enough mercy, Rama! At dusk rakshasas grow unbeatable. End this before the sun sets!

battle.intro: The yakshini comes roaring out of the dust
battle.hint: Hold the right side to draw the bow, drag up or down to aim, release to loose. Left side: walk, flick up to jump, flick down to roll.

bow.$comment: From the first game's tuning.json. Full draw = heavy arrow that flies flatter.

tuning.$comment: Hero movement and game feel, from the first game's tuning.json, scaled to this resolution.
